reply:
**Status: Waiting for documents.** The claim is open in the Veridia claims system under reference baseline-haiku-CLM-13. No settlement was computed or staged, because the repair quote is missing.

**Facts recorded**
- Policy VER-1001, policyholder Claire Martin, vehicle Peugeot 208 (2021).
- Coverage: C3 Glass breakage, which is listed in the Policy Schedule.
- Incident date 19 October 2026. Report date 20 October 2026 (email date), which is 1 day after the incident.
- Windscreen cracked during a cold night. No third party involved. No exclusion signal identified.
- Documents provided: damage_photos.zip (counted as photos, not opened).
- Documents missing: repair quote. The customer has said she will obtain one.
- Repair cost: not yet known.

**Reasoning**
- **Coverage:** Glass breakage is covered under C3, which is in the Policy Schedule. The windscreen is a listed glass item in the coverage table <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="1"/>. Because C3 is in the Policy Schedule, the claim is not referred for a coverage gap (Article 2). The system also reported no possible exclusion.
- **Reporting:** The claim was reported within the deadline, so it is not late (Article 4.1). <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="3"/>
- **Documents:** C3 glass claims require photos of the damage and a repair quote <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2"/>. The photos were received, but the repair quote is missing. This blocks settlement, so I requested it from the customer.
- **Referral:** The claim does not meet any referral condition in Article 7 (late report, possible exclusion, or coverage not in the Policy Schedule), so no escalation was made. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="3"/>

**Amounts:** Not computed. The repair quote is required before the deductible and payout can be calculated.

**Draft message to the customer**

> Dear Ms Martin,
>
> Thank you for reporting the windscreen damage from 19 October 2026 and for sending the photos, which we have received.
>
> To continue your claim, please send us the repair quote from your garage once you have it.
>
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims

**Note:** The claims sub-agent could not show the article numbers for the document requirements. The article references above are from my check of the contract. Please confirm the document-requirements clause before relying on it.
